## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: strong sector breadth but major megacap divergences (AAPL, AVGO, JPM BELOW TREND while META/AMD/NEM are ABOVE TREND) and mixed sector leadership; Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: PLD (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -5.15% | 1M: +7.45%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Industrials under pressure: GE (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -6.38%) BELOW TREND, MMM (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TJX (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.75%) BELOW TREND; MMM (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND; PLD (1W: -5.09% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND; PSA (1W: -5.15% | 1M: +7.45%) TREND EXHAUSTION; TGT (1W: -6.58% | 1M: +10.24%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: NEM (1W: +10.34%), GILD (1W: +10.30%), META (1W: +8.40%), AMD (1W: +8.40%), NOW (1W: +7.09% | 1M: -11.67%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — watch NOW as a tactical bounce rather than confirmed trend change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with internal rotation: META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +16.94%) ABOVE TREND offset by AVGO (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -7.01%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -1.45%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL; Sector 1W: +0.38% (19 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft overall: JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -8.36%) BELOW TREND while V (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -7.04%) shows short-term lift; Sector 1W: -1.32% (20 stocks) — watch for continued dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthy and defensive: UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND; Sector 1W: +2.03% (15 stocks) — strength confirmed but monitor UNH news flow.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Healthcare and Materials exposure and selective Energy names (XOM, SLB) given confirmed ABOVE TREND moves; reduce exposure to weak Financials and underperforming Industrials until trend stability returns. Style: mixed — Growth/Momentum pockets (META/AMD) but significant megacap divergence keeps allocation cautious.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -6.22%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.93% | 1M: -11.07%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.44%), Healthcare (1W: +2.03%), Energy (1W: +2.20%) — monitor follow-through.  
BEARISH: Financials (1W: -1.32%), Real Estate (1W: -2.61%), Industrials (1W: -1.53%) — watch for widening weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch for META/AMD continued 1W strength to confirm durable leadership; NVDA reclaiming a sustained 1M positive would reduce POTENTIAL REVERSAL risk; AAPL needs a sustained weekly bid to escape BELOW TREND; JPM must stabilize 1W to avoid deeper financial sector pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
WMT (+50): WMT (1W: -1.72% | 1M: +6.08%) TREND EXHAUSTION — positive upgrade news contrasts with 1W pullback, watch for confirmation.  
(Other high-score bullish names noted in feeds: CRM, MDT, GS — cross-check intra-day price action for follow-through.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-55): UNH (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND — news-driven weakness is currently diverging from price, monitor for distribution.  
JPM (-50): JPM (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness and is a downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION regime, breadth 7/11 sectors positive and leadership Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed with pockets of Growth/Momentum but notable dispersion. META (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +19.64%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +10.30% | 1M: +10.06%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is megacap and financial divergence plus headline-driven moves (UNH news divergence, JPM headline risk) — monitor for confirmed breadth or a decisive trend break.
